newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moslem rebels kill 42 in Algeria massacre - paper.
newsitem.headline: Moslem rebels kill 42 in Algeria massacre - paper.

text.p: Moslem rebels killed 42 people in a village south of Algiers early on Wednesday, the second massacre in Algeria within 24 hours, the Algerian newspaper El Watan said on Thursday.

El Watan, usually well informed on security issues, said 17 women and three babies were among those killed in the attack on Omaria village in Medea district. They were hacked to death with axes and swords, the newspaper said.

The attack, which started on Tuesday night and went into Wednesday morning, came less than 24 hours after 93 people were slaughtered in Haouch Boughlef-Khemisti only 25 km (15 miles) from the capital.
That massacre, confirmed by the government, was the worst in five years of conflict between Moslem rebels and security forces.
There has been no official confirmation of the attack on Omaria.
